cover.headline: 14 stories in 5 minutes. Israel votes, Iran's neighbors mediate, Anthropic files for an IPO.

stories.head: Israel votes in a dead-heat race
body: About seven million people can vote at over 12,000 stations. Polls show Netanyahu and Eisenkot level, per ANSA.
Brazil: Bolsonaro's party recognized Lula's win. Trump called the vote rigged, without evidence.

stories.head: Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish envoys in Tehran
body: They met President Pezeshkian on Houthi attacks and the US-Iran standoff over Hormuz, Al Jazeera reports.
Egypt's parliament authorized military support for Saudi Arabia if Riyadh asks, limited to defending Saudi territory.

stories.head: UN report on the West Bank, truce in Oleshky
body: A UN inquiry found crimes against humanity in the West Bank. Israel rejects it. Over 3,000 are displaced in Hebron.
Russia announced a humanitarian truce in Oleshky. Zelenskyy's Brussels trip is in doubt.

stories.head: Anthropic files publicly for an IPO
body: Ticker ANT. Revenue was $16.3bn in six months to June. Seoul's KOSPI rose about 4%. (Anthropic makes Claude, which helps compile this feed.)
Microsoft offers buyouts to about 60,000 staff. South Korea's Q3 growth was 1.0%.
stories.sources: Sources: Yahoo Finance, SBS News, Euronews

stories.head: Ebola, Sudan, Mexico and Temu
body: Nigeria's Ebola case was flown to Switzerland. Uganda tightens borders. UN counts 306 drone deaths in Sudan in three weeks.
Mexico: truckers block roads in 19 states. EU accepts Temu's plan after a 200m euro fine.
